invalidated_claims: The scanned fetchWithRetry utility represented a reachable shipped runtime failure at the time the original receipt was created.
The documented retry behavior propagated to every downstream consumer of the CopilotKit runtime.
preserved_claims: Issue #3637 identified the retry utility through static analysis.
The retry utility contained the code shape described by the original static-analysis finding.
PR #3842 subsequently changed the utility's Retry-After handling.

evidence.supports: The original finding was explicitly presented as static analysis rather than a runtime-specific reproduction.
The retry utility's Retry-After handling was subsequently changed.
CopilotKit maintainer investigation states that fetchWithRetry had no shipped runtime callers and that its last callers were removed during the v1.50.0 reimplementation.

notes: This correction does not erase or rewrite the original receipt. It narrows the evidentiary claims that may be drawn from it. The static-analysis finding and subsequent code change remain part of the historical record; runtime reachability and downstream propagation do not remain admissible claims.
